requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, SPI row ("000b to 101b ... selects channel 0 … 5; the interface settings are to be applied according to this selection; the CSN pin assigned to this selection is to be asserted"), TC18.txt L4076-4079

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a channel's transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transfer-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerTransferComplete event carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.3.1 Table 41: spi trigger outputs ("0 SPI execution done"), TC18.txt L4606-4611

requirements.title: Chip-select-edge triggers bracket each transfer in order
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerChipSelectEdge asserted event immediately before, and a deasserted event immediately after, each transfer's byte exchange, and spi.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return all queued events in that recorded order.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.3.1 Table 41: spi trigger outputs ("2 + 2 x n  CSn asserted (with 0 =< n < 16)" / "3 + 2 x n  CSn de-asserted (with 0 =< n < 16)"), TC18.txt L4606-4611

requirements.title: Config.Validate rejects an implausible channel and round-trips all slots
requirements.text: spi.Config.Validate shall return ErrZeroClock or ErrInvalidMode for any enabled channel with a zero clock rate or an unrecognized Mode, and spi.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip all MaxChannels channel slots including disabled ones.

requirements.title: SPI decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: spi.DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer, and spi.DecodeTransferRequest/DecodeTransferResponse shall never panic on arbitrary input — every byte sequence, including the empty one, is a structurally valid SPI payload.

requirements.title: SPI golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: spi.EncodeConfig and spi.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input, with the transfer-request body carrying the SPI payload alone and no leading channel sub-opcode byte.

requirements.title: SPI applies TC18 Table 30's SPI row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: spi.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassChannelSelect, and spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reach each of the six channels via evt[2:0] = 000b..101b, reject evt[2:0] = 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without performing any bus transfer, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access that is not presented on any SPI bus.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, SPI row ("000b to 101b ... selects channel 0 … 5 ... 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4076-4084

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces bus speed validity when enabled
requirements.text: i2c.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of Speed, and shall return ErrInvalidSpeed for an enabled bus whose Speed is not one of this package's five recognized values.

requirements.title: BusSpeed.Valid recognizes exactly the five defined speed classes
requirements.text: i2c.BusSpeed.Valid shall return true for exactly SpeedStandard through SpeedUltraFast and false for any other value; this package's numbering is its own reasoned resolution of an ambiguous/colliding bus-speed enumeration in the source behavioral description, flagged as an open item pending confirmation against a public interoperability reference.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.7.2 Table 49: i2c functional configuration, i2c_mode field ("0: Standard Mode 100kbit/s / 1: Fast Mode 400kbit/s / 2: Fast Mode plus 1Mbit/s / 3: High-speed mode 1.7Mbit/s / 3: High-speed mode 3.4Mbit/s / 4: Ultra-fast mode 5 Mbit/s" — value 3 is listed twice in the source table against two different data rates, the same collision this package's own doc.go flags as unresolved), TC18.txt L5224-5231

requirements.title: I2C Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a transfer against a disabled bus
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrBusNotConfigured when a transfer request is handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transaction-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerEvent carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer, and Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return queued events in FIFO order and clear the queue.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.7.4 ("An I²C endpoint optionally generates HW trigger events"), TC18.txt L5264

requirements.title: I2C decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: i2c.DecodeConfig and i2c.DecodeTransferRequest shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: I2C golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig and i2c.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: I²C applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: i2c.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4085-4092

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits when enabled
requirements.text: uart.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, and for an enabled endpoint shall return ErrZeroBaudRate, ErrInvalidDataBits, ErrInvalidParity, or ErrInvalidStopBits as appropriate for an implausible field.

requirements.title: Parity.Valid and StopBits.Valid recognize exactly their defined values
requirements.text: uart.Parity.Valid shall return true for exactly ParityNone through ParitySpace and false otherwise; uart.StopBits.Valid shall return true for exactly StopBitsOne through StopBitsTwo and false otherwise.

requirements.title: UART Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: uart.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Write to TX and Read to RX, rejecting neither flag or a non-payload-less read
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall dispatch a request with FlagWrite set to TX and a request with FlagRead set to RX, shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set, and shall return ErrReadRequestNotPayloadLess for a read request carrying a nonempty body.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.8.1 ("A read request having a byte_msg_payload will be rejected with error code = UNKNOWN_CMD."), TC18.txt L5303

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects the wrong endpoint, an ungranted stream, or a disabled endpoint
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint when a request's ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant, and ErrUARTNotConfigured when the endpoint's Config.Enabled is false.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: TX uses the configured Transport, defaults to TX-to-RX loopback, and queues a TX-complete trigger
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint shall transmit through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, shall default to looping transmitted bytes directly into its own RX FIFO when none is set, and shall queue a TriggerTXComplete event carrying the accepted byte count for every TX write.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.8.4 Table 52 ("uart trigger signals" — "0  Transmit request finalized", "1  Read request finalized"), TC18.txt L5416-5421

requirements.title: RX read drains the FIFO up to the requested count and reports partial delivery on underfill
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint's RX read handling shall drain up to the request's ReadSizeOrSegment bytes from the RX FIFO, reporting complete=false and returning fewer bytes when the FIFO cannot fill the full request, and complete=true once the full requested count is available.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.8.1 ("A read request will be started as soon as the fifo-rx-buffer is filled with as many bytes as requested in the read_size or when the uart_timeout has expired or in case the read_size is larger than the uart_rx_fifo_size, when the fifo is full. In the latter case the response is fragmented."), TC18.txt L5297-5299

requirements.title: Receive appends to the RX FIFO and queues an RX-data-available trigger
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.Receive shall append its argument to the RX FIFO and queue a TriggerRXDataAvailable event carrying the newly arrived byte count, and Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return queued events in FIFO order and clear the queue.

requirements.title: UART decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: uart.DecodeConfig, uart.DecodeReadResponse, and uart.DecodeWriteResponse shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: UART golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: uart.EncodeConfig and uart.EncodeReadResponse shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: UART applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: uart.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4085-4092

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces resolution, sample count, and enum bounds when enabled
requirements.text: adc.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled channel regardless of its other fields, and for an enabled channel shall return ErrInvalidResolution, ErrInvalidSampleCount, ErrInvalidCombineMode, or ErrInvalidTriggerMode as appropriate for an implausible field.

requirements.title: CombineMode.Valid and TriggerMode.Valid recognize exactly their defined values
requirements.text: adc.CombineMode.Valid shall return true for exactly CombineReplace and CombineRollingAverage and false otherwise; adc.TriggerMode.Valid shall return true for exactly TriggerModeOnDemand through TriggerModeSelf and false otherwise.

requirements.title: ADC Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: adc.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Trigger samples, averages, and combines, masked to the configured resolution
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.Trigger shall take Config.SampleCount raw readings from the configured Transport, arithmetic-average them, combine the average with the endpoint's previous value under Config.Combine, mask the result to Config.ResolutionBits, and queue a TriggerMeasurementDone event carrying that value.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.9.1 ("For the readings acquired during the averaging interval given in number of samples (an implementation may decide to fix this to 1) the average is calculated. Finally, the COMBINE_NR_VAL defines how many measurement values (i.e. averaging results) will be put in one response frame."), TC18.txt L5455-5457

requirements.title: Trigger rejects a disabled channel and defaults to an always-zero sample source
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.Trigger shall return ErrChannelNotConfigured when Config.Enabled is false, and shall treat every raw sample as zero when no Transport is set via SetTransport.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write, rejecting neither flag, the wrong endpoint, or an ungranted stream
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a manual trigger for a request with FlagWrite set, shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: A plain read samples fresh under TriggerModeOnDemand and returns the cached value otherwise
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a fresh Trigger for a read request when Config.TriggerMode is TriggerModeOnDemand, and shall instead return the endpoint's latest already-measured value without sampling when TriggerMode is TriggerModeExternal or TriggerModeSelf.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.9.1 ("Anyhow, the RC Client may request ADCs reading at any time. Once a reading is requested, then the ADC samples."), TC18.txt L5450-5451

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued measurement-done events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: adc.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: ADC decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: adc.DecodeConfig and adc.DecodeValue shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: ADC golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: adc.EncodeConfig and adc.EncodeValue shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: ADC applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: adc.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and adc.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4085-4092

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces role and the default output waveform's active/period invariant
requirements.text: pwm.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, ErrInvalidRole for an enabled endpoint whose Role is not recognized, and ErrActiveExceedsPeriod for an enabled RoleOutput endpoint whose DefaultActiveMicros exceeds DefaultPeriodMicros.

requirements.title: Role.Valid recognizes exactly the two defined roles
requirements.text: pwm.Role.Valid shall return true for exactly RoleOutput and RoleInput and false for any other value.

requirements.title: PWM Config and waveform encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: pwm.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig and pwm.EncodeWaveform/DecodeWaveform shall round-trip their respective structures and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write, rejecting neither flag, the wrong endpoint, an ungranted stream, or a disabled endpoint
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant, and ErrNotConfigured when the endpoint's Config.Enabled is false.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: A write request is only accepted for a RoleOutput endpoint and rejects an implausible waveform
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWriteNotSupportedForInput for a write request against a RoleInput endpoint, and shall return ErrActiveExceedsPeriod for a write request whose ActiveMicros exceeds its PeriodMicros.

requirements.title: Configure applies a RoleOutput endpoint's default waveform, and writes go through the configured OutputTransport
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.Configure shall immediately apply a RoleOutput Config's default waveform exactly as a write request would, and Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply subsequent write requests through the configured OutputTransport when one is set via SetOutputTransport, defaulting to storing the waveform for readback when none is set.

requirements.title: A RoleInput read returns the captured waveform and fails explicitly on signal loss
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the most recently captured waveform for a read request against a RoleInput endpoint, through the configured InputTransport when one is set via SetInputTransport or via SetCapturedWaveform/SetSignalLost otherwise, and shall return ErrSignalLost rather than stale data when no valid waveform has been captured or signal loss was most recently reported.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.6.1 ("If the period of the incoming signal exceeds the configured maximum allowed period or if the external PWM source stops, the PWM_IN endpoint will detect this and if enabled within the EP_config (EP_RESP_ON_ERR) notify the RC Client with an error response message."), TC18.txt L5078-5080

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued output/capture/signal-loss events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: pwm.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: PWM decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: pwm.DecodeConfig and pwm.DecodeWaveform shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: PWM golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: pwm.EncodeConfig and pwm.EncodeWaveform shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: PWM applies TC18 Table 30 per role, and PWM_OUT combines per 16-bit field
requirements.text: pwm.EVTClassFor shall return acf.EVTClassArithmetic for RoleOutput and acf.EVTClassConfigOnly for RoleInput or any unrecognized role, matching TC18 §13.5 Table 30's placement of PWM_OUT and PWM_IN in different rows. pwm.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply the evt[2:0]-selected combining rule to a PWM_OUT write independently for each of the payload's two 16-bit fields, saturating at 0x0000 and 0xFFFF per Table 30's note; reject evt[2:0] = 100b (RoleOutput) or 001b-110b (RoleInput) with acf.ErrEVTReserved without altering the applied waveform; reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload; and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access that is not presented at the waveform generator.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field — GPIO/PWM_OUT row ("000b The byte_msg_payload is presented at the interface ... 001b/010b/011b [OR/AND/XOR with current interface status] ... 100b reserved – request shall be ignored and an err-response with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD shall be sent ... 101b/110b [add/subtract] ... 111b [reconfigure]") for RoleOutput, and ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint") for RoleInput, TC18.txt L4085-4119

requirements.title: Kind.Valid and IsCancellation recognize exactly the defined values
requirements.text: request.Kind.Valid shall return true for exactly the eight non-plain Kind constants (KindCompound through KindCancelSequencer) and false for KindPlain and any value at or beyond the sentinel; request.Kind.IsCancellation shall return true for exactly KindCancelAll, KindCancelTransaction, and KindCancelSequencer.

requirements.title: Kind.Priority implements the fixed cross-type execution-priority ordering
requirements.text: request.Kind.Priority shall rank the three cancellation variants equally and ahead of every other Kind, followed in order by KindChained, KindTriggered, KindTimed, KindCompoundWait, KindCompound, and KindPlain last.
requirements.tc18: §12.9.2 ("In case two or more requests are due for execution then the priorities are as follows: 1. cancellation 2. triggered 3. timed 4. compound 5. compound wait 6. chained 7. standard"), TC18.txt L3652-3661

requirements.title: CompareOp.Evaluate and Valid implement the six comparison operators
requirements.text: request.CompareOp.Evaluate shall correctly implement equal/not-equal/less/less-or-equal/greater/greater-or-equal for its six defined values, and CompareOp.Valid shall return false for any value at or beyond the sentinel.

requirements.title: Sequencer registers wrap on Advance and only advance on a matched Conditional
requirements.text: request.Sequencer.Advance shall add its delta modulo 2^32 (wrapping rather than saturating), each SequencerID shall address an independent register starting at zero, and evaluating a Conditional shall advance its register only when the comparison holds.
requirements.tc18: §12.10 ("[an implementation] may support only a lower number of sequencers"), TC18.txt L3871

requirements.title: Compound/CompoundWait envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompound/DecodeCompound and EncodeCompoundWait/DecodeCompoundWait shall round-trip a Conditional and (for Compound) an inner Control/Body, PeekKind shall report the leading Kind byte without consuming the rest of the buffer, and each decoder shall reject a short buffer, trailing bytes, or a mismatched Kind tag.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.2 Figure 8 ("GBB message for compound requests") + §11.2.2.3 Figure 9 ("GBB message for compound wait requests"), TC18.txt L1394-1406,1494-1504

requirements.title: Triggered/Timed envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeTriggered/DecodeTriggered and EncodeTimed/DecodeTimed shall round-trip their trigger source or target execution time alongside an inner Control/Body.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.5 ("Each endpoint may be configured to start a request upon receiving a selected trigger signal") + §11.2.2.7 Figure 13 ("Timed request"), TC18.txt L1691,1871-1880

requirements.title: Cancellation envelopes and responses round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeCancelAll/DecodeCancelAll, EncodeCancelTransaction/DecodeCancelTransaction, and EncodeCancelSequencer/DecodeCancelSequencer shall round-trip their scope, and EncodeConditionalResponse/DecodeConditionalResponse and EncodeCancelResponse/DecodeCancelResponse shall round-trip their result payloads.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.3.1 Figure 14 ("Request cancellation of all requests in EP request queue") + §11.2.3.2 Figure 15 + §11.2.3.3 Figure 16 (narrower cancellation variants), TC18.txt L1986-1997,2058-2069,2145-2156

requirements.title: Chained request envelopes round-trip through Encode/Decode
requirements.text: request.EncodeChained/DecodeChained shall round-trip an ordered list of ChainedSegment values, reject zero segments, and reject a truncated buffer.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.6 Figure 12 ("ACF_GBB for chained requests"), TC18.txt L1781-1789

requirements.title: Chained response bodies preserve fail-fast abort information
requirements.text: request.EncodeChainedResponse/DecodeChainedResponse shall round-trip a partial ChainedResult, preserving which segment (if any) is marked Failed and the original Total segment count even when fewer segments actually ran.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.6 ("request will not be executed in case the previous request returned an error, as a consequence the remainder of the chain is not executed, and the request send an error response with error code = CHAIN_ABORTED"), TC18.txt L1835-1837

requirements.title: request package decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: Every DecodeXxx function in the request package shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: Dispatcher retrofits KindPlain requests onto the wrapped Handler unchanged
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall dispatch a Message without avtp.FlagExtended set directly to its wrapped Handler with the same Control/Body semantics a Phase 14 endpoint's own HandleRequest already implements, and the resulting response shall not carry avtp.FlagExtended.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.1 ("unconditional execution of request (mandatory feature)"), TC18.txt L1204

requirements.title: Dispatcher gates KindCompound execution and sequencer advance on a match
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall call the wrapped Handler for a KindCompound ticket only when its Conditional matches, shall advance the addressed sequencer register only on a match, and shall report ConditionalResult.Matched and the resulting sequencer value in the response regardless of outcome.
requirements.tc18: §11.2 ("Compound requests: Execution is based on sequencer states and starts when the sequencer is in the state that is specified in the request"), TC18.txt L1165-1167

requirements.title: Dispatcher never calls the wrapped Handler for KindCompoundWait
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall evaluate a KindCompoundWait ticket's Conditional and report its outcome without ever calling the wrapped Handler, regardless of whether the condition matches.
requirements.tc18: §11.2 ("Compound wait requests: This type of request does not change any interface status. It creates a response as soon as an interface reaches that status specified in the request"), TC18.txt L1168-1171

requirements.title: Dispatcher defers KindTriggered execution until its TriggerPump reports an event
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a KindTriggered ticket pending until its registered TriggerPump for the referenced source reports at least one new event, shall call each distinct source's TriggerPump at most once per Pump call, and shall consume at most one reported event per satisfied ticket.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.5 ("Each endpoint may be configured to start a request upon receiving a selected trigger signal"), TC18.txt L1691

requirements.title: Dispatcher defers KindTimed execution until the caller-supplied clock reaches its target
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a KindTimed ticket pending until called with now at or past its encoded target execution time.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.7 ("In any case the presentation_time is the earliest point in time, when the request shall be executed"), TC18.txt L1952

requirements.title: Dispatcher executes KindChained segments strictly in order and aborts on failure
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall call the wrapped Handler once per ChainedSegment in declared order, and shall stop executing remaining segments (without skipping ahead) the moment one segment's Handler call returns an error, reporting ErrChainedSegmentFailed.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.6 ("the second and following requests always wait on the predecessor request to finish its execution"), TC18.txt L1793-1795

requirements.title: Cancellation kinds clear only their declared scope of pending tickets
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher shall have KindCancelAll finalize every other pending ticket, KindCancelTransaction finalize only the pending ticket matching its TransactionNum, and KindCancelSequencer finalize only pending KindCompound/KindCompoundWait tickets gated on its SequencerID, each reporting ErrTicketCancelled and leaving every non-matching pending ticket untouched.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.3.1 ("Clear all requests from an EP request storage that have been received in the same stream as the request for cancellation"), TC18.txt L1983-1985

requirements.title: Dispatcher.Submit enforces the configured AccessCheck before any decoding
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Submit shall reject a request with the AccessCheck's error, for every Kind including KindCompoundWait and every cancellation variant, when a non-nil AccessCheck rejects the requester.

requirements.title: Dispatcher.Pump applies the fixed cross-type priority ordering within one call
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Pump shall execute every ticket that becomes ready within one call in Kind.Priority order (lower rank first), regardless of submission order, when more than one ticket on the same Dispatcher becomes eligible simultaneously.
requirements.tc18: §12.9.2 ("In case two or more requests are due for execution then the priorities are as follows: 1. cancellation 2. triggered 3. timed 4. compound 5. compound wait 6. chained 7. standard"), TC18.txt L3652-3661

requirements.title: Dispatcher ticket bookkeeping (Response/StateOf/Forget/Pending) behaves correctly
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Response shall report ErrUnknownTicket for an unissued or Forgotten TicketID and ErrPending for a ticket not yet StateFinalized; Forget shall discard only a finalized ticket's bookkeeping and be a no-op otherwise; Pending shall count only tickets not yet StateFinalized.
requirements.tc18: §12.9.3 ("a request moves through the states request pending, request started (RS), request under execution (RE), and request finalized (RF)"), TC18.txt L3679-3684

requirements.title: request package golden vectors pin the frozen conditional-request wire byte layout
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompound and EncodeCancelAll shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input, and dispatching a golden KindCompound envelope end-to-end against a real endpoint shall produce the expected wrapped response.

requirements.title: Kind safety-request tagging (IsSafety/Base/Valid/Priority) is correct
requirements.text: request.Kind.IsSafety and Kind.Base shall round-trip losslessly for KindCompoundSafety/KindCompoundWaitSafety/KindTriggeredSafety against their respective base Kind; Kind.Valid shall accept exactly those three safety-tagged values and reject KindSafetyFlag applied to any other base Kind; Kind.Priority shall rank a safety-request Kind identically to its Base kind.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2 ("If the MSB of the identifier (0x8x) is set the request is treated as a safety request and will not be deleted when the EP needs to go to safe state"), TC18.txt L1257-1259

requirements.title: Safety-request envelope encoders share their base kind's Decode function
requirements.text: request.EncodeCompoundSafety, EncodeCompoundWaitSafety, and EncodeTriggeredSafety shall produce envelopes with an identical body layout to their base-kind Encode counterpart differing only in the leading Kind byte, decodable by the same DecodeCompound/DecodeCompoundWait/DecodeTriggered function as the base kind, with PeekKind reporting the safety-tagged Kind value.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2 Table 5 ("Different types of conditional requests", listing 0x0F/0x8F Compound, 0x0B/0x8B Compound wait, 0x0E/0x8E Triggered), TC18.txt L1260-1267

requirements.title: Dispatcher gates safety-request Kinds on a configured SafeStateCheck
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.Submit shall reject a safety-request Kind with ErrSafeStateNotConfigured when no SafeStateCheck is configured, and Dispatcher.Pump shall leave a safety-request ticket in StateStarted on every call for which SetSafeStateCheck's configured function reports false for that ticket's requester, advancing it only once that function reports true.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2 ("If the MSB of the identifier (0x8x) is set the request is treated as a safety request and will not be deleted when the EP needs to go to safe state"), TC18.txt L1257-1259

requirements.title: Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety clears only non-safety pending tickets
requirements.text: request.Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety shall finalize every not-yet-finalized ticket whose Kind is not a safety-request variant with ErrPurgedByWatchdog, and shall leave every safety-request ticket's state and pending status completely unchanged.
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2 ("If the MSB of the identifier (0x8x) is set the request is treated as a safety request and will not be deleted when the EP needs to go to safe state"), TC18.txt L1257-1259

requirements.title: Compute covers stream addressing, message addressing/timestamp fields, and the whole message
requirements.text: e2e.Compute shall be deterministic for a given (stream, Message) pair, and shall produce a different CRC32 value when the stream, ByteBusID, TransactionNum, Control, ReadSizeOrSegment, Timestamp, or Body of its input changes.
requirements.tc18: §13.6 Figures 19-20 (CRC scope: stream_id + avtp_timestamp + whole message), TC18.txt L3809-3812

requirements.title: Protect/Verify round-trip a message through a trailing CRC32 safe point
requirements.text: e2e.Protect shall append a Len-byte trailing CRC32 safe point to a Message's Body computed by Compute over the message as given, and e2e.Verify shall strip and validate that trailing field, returning a Message with Body restored to its original contents when the safe point is valid.
requirements.tc18: §13.6 Table 31 (CRC32P4 parameters) + acf_msg_length quadlet adjustment, TC18.txt L3792-3815

requirements.title: Verify rejects a short or mismatched safe point without exposing a usable message
requirements.text: e2e.Verify shall report ErrShortSafePoint when a message's Body is shorter than Len, and shall report ErrCRCMismatch without returning a usable inner message when the trailing CRC32 does not match the CRC recomputed over any covered field, including a tampered payload byte with an otherwise-intact trailing CRC.
requirements.tc18: §13.6, CRC-mismatch handling on request receipt, TC18.txt L3827-3828

requirements.title: ComputeFragmented matches Compute over an equivalent reassembled single message
requirements.text: e2e.ComputeFragmented, given a shared header and a slice of per-segment Body byte slices, shall produce exactly the CRC32 that e2e.Compute would produce for a single message carrying the same header with Body set to every segment's Body concatenated in order.
requirements.tc18: §13.6 (fragmented-request CRC over first AVTPDU/ACF header only), TC18.txt L3816-3823

requirements.title: Guard skips the wrapped Handler on a CRC failure and re-Protects a successful response
requirements.text: e2e.Guard.HandleRequest shall not call its wrapped request.Handler and shall return ErrCRCMismatch when the inbound message's safe point fails Verify, and shall call the wrapped Handler with the Verify-recovered inner message and return that Handler's response re-Protected with a fresh safe point when the inbound safe point is valid.

requirements.title: Supervisor.Observe enforces configured sequence monotonicity and overflow wraparound
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.Observe shall report an error wrapping ErrSequenceViolation and sticky-trip that stream when StreamConfig.RequireMonotonicSequence is set and an arrival's sequence number does not strictly follow the previous one, shall accept a wraparound from the maximum uint32 value to zero when SequenceOverflowWraps is also set, and shall always rearm the stream's inter-arrival timeout clock regardless of whether a violation was recorded.

requirements.title: Supervisor.InSafeState reflects inter-arrival Timeout on its injectable clock
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.InSafeState shall report true for a stream Observe has never been called for, false immediately after a qualifying Observe call, and true again once the stream's configured Timeout has elapsed since its last Observe call, all measured against the Supervisor's injectable clock function.

requirements.title: Supervisor.CheckFunc matches InSafeState and Reset clears a sticky trip
requirements.text: e2e.Supervisor.CheckFunc's returned request.SafeStateCheck shall report exactly the same boolean InSafeState reports for the same stream at the same call, and Supervisor.Reset shall clear a stream's sticky monotonicity-violation trip and rearm its timeout clock from the moment Reset is called.

requirements.title: Supervisor-driven safe-state gating and watchdog purge integrate correctly with Dispatcher
requirements.text: Wiring a e2e.Supervisor's CheckFunc into a request.Dispatcher's SetSafeStateCheck, and calling Dispatcher.PurgeNonSafety once Supervisor.InSafeState reports true for a stream, shall finalize that Dispatcher's ordinary pending tickets for that stream with ErrPurgedByWatchdog while leaving a submitted safety-request ticket pending until InSafeState itself reports true, at which point that surviving ticket shall execute normally on the next Pump call.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero baud rate when enabled
requirements.text: lin.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of BaudRate, and shall return ErrInvalidBaudRate for an enabled bus whose BaudRate is zero.

requirements.title: LIN Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: lin.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a non-write request, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite for a request without the Write control flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a transfer against a disabled bus
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrBusNotConfigured for a transfer request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: A transfer is performed through the configured Transport, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a transfer request through the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set, and shall default to echoing the transmitted bytes back (loopback) when none is set.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns queued transaction-complete events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: lin.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: LIN decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: lin.DecodeConfig and lin.DecodeTransferRequest shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: LIN golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: lin.EncodeConfig and lin.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: LIN applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: lin.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and lin.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4085-4092

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero nominal bitrate when enabled
requirements.text: can.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of its bitrate fields, and shall return ErrInvalidBitrate for an enabled bus whose NominalBitrateKbps is zero.

requirements.title: CAN Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: can.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Format.Valid recognizes exactly the three defined frame formats
requirements.text: can.Format.Valid shall return true for exactly FormatClassical, FormatFD, and FormatXL, and false for any other value.

requirements.title: Frame.Validate enforces per-format payload caps, ID width, and field applicability
requirements.text: can.Frame.Validate shall return ErrInvalidFormat for an unrecognized Format, ErrIDOutOfRange when ID exceeds its Extended/standard width, ErrPayloadTooLarge when Data exceeds Format's maximum payload length, ErrBitRateSwitchNotSupported for a FormatClassical frame with BitRateSwitch set, and ErrXLHeaderNotSupported for a non-FormatXL frame with a nonzero XLHeader.

requirements.title: CAN Frame encoder/decoder round-trips for every frame format and never panics
requirements.text: can.EncodeFrame/DecodeFrame shall round-trip a Frame for FormatClassical, FormatFD, and FormatXL (including XLHeader and up to XLMaxPayload bytes of Data), and DecodeFrame shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request with neither flag, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither FlagRead nor FlagWrite set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a request against a disabled bus
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrNotConfigured for a request handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: A write request validates, echoes, and transmits through the configured Transport
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall reject a write request whose decoded Frame fails Validate before ever reaching Transport, shall echo an accepted Frame back in the response, and shall hand it to the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set.

requirements.title: A read request returns the most recently received Frame or fails explicitly
requirements.text: can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the Frame most recently recorded via SetReceivedFrame for a read request, and shall return ErrNoFrameReceived rather than a stale or zero-value Frame when none has been received yet.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.11.1 ("The CAN controller creates responses upon reception of CAN frames."), TC18.txt L5762

requirements.title: CAN golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: can.EncodeConfig and can.EncodeFrame shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: CAN applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: can.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and can.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
requirements.tc18: §13.5 Table 33: EP specific usage of evt-field, ADC/PWM_IN/I²C/LIN/CAN/UART/ISELED/MDIO row ("000b to 110b reserved – request to be rejected with error code = UNSUPPORTED_CMD ... 111b The byte_msg_payload is not presented to the interface but used to change the configuration of the endpoint"), TC18.txt L4085-4092

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces a nonzero device count when enabled
requirements.text: iseled.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled chain regardless of DeviceCount, and shall return ErrInvalidDeviceCount for an enabled chain whose DeviceCount is zero.

requirements.title: ISELED Config encoder/decoder round-trips and never panics
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config, and DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: Command encoder/decoder round-trips and detects a corrupted ISELED-native CRC
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeCommand/DecodeCommand shall round-trip a Command, DecodeCommand shall return ErrCRCMismatch when the trailing CRC8 does not match the one ComputeCRC recomputes over the decoded Address and Data, and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: AggregatedResponse encoder/decoder round-trips for zero, one, and several device responses
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeAggregatedResponse/DecodeAggregatedResponse shall round-trip an AggregatedResponse of any length, and DecodeAggregatedResponse shall return ErrShortBuffer rather than panicking when the buffer does not contain enough bytes for its declared entry count.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a non-write request, the wrong endpoint, and an ungranted stream
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite for a request without the Write control flag set, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a command against a disabled chain or an out-of-range device address
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrChainNotConfigured for a command handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false, and ErrDeviceAddressOutOfRange for a targeted Command whose Address is not DeviceBroadcast and is not less than the configured DeviceCount.
requirements.tc18: §13.1 ("A used endpoint might be enabled or disabled. If enabled, it starts processing requests from its request storage. If disabled, the processing is stopped, and the RC Client can e.g. preload the storage with a sequence of requests to executed as soon as the endpoint gets enabled."), TC18.txt L3907-3909

requirements.title: A targeted command exchanges through the default loopback or the configured Transport, and queues a trigger
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall answer a targeted Command with a single-entry AggregatedResponse echoing its Data through the default loopback with no Transport configured, or through the Transport configured via SetTransport when one is set, and shall queue a TriggerEvent recording the response count on every exchange.
requirements.tc18: §13.7.12.1 ("The ISELED endpoint creates a single trigger event, when transmission of a data packet has been completed on the ISELED network."), TC18.txt L5913-5914

requirements.title: A DeviceBroadcast command's default loopback aggregates one response per configured device
requirements.text: iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall answer a Command addressed to DeviceBroadcast with an AggregatedResponse containing one entry per device 0..Config.DeviceCount-1, each echoing the command's Data, when no Transport is configured.

requirements.title: ISELED golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: iseled.EncodeConfig and iseled.EncodeCommand shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: ISELED applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: iseled.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and iseled.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.
